prompt: A costume-department prop photograph for image-to-3D reconstruction: ONE single armour piece alone, the lower part of his red dujeong-gap brigandine: the riveted armour skirt, a front-split wrap of thick red riveted panels with black gold-edged trims hanging from the waist to just above the knee, open at the front centre and at the sides for the legs; no belt, no torso.
